displayName: Send Personalized Outreach That Sounds Like You
summary: Research, write, send, and improve outreach that sounds like you.

useCases.title: Send personalized outreach that sounds like me
useCases.message: Help me send personalized outreach to this list. Use what you know about my voice and context, research only where it will help, and start with a small set I can review. Before sending, show me the exact recipients, messages, channels, and timing—and explain when thoughtful follow-ups or a sequence would be useful.

useCases.title: Send founder-led outreach that sounds like me
useCases.message: Help me reach out to these customers, partners, or investors in my own voice. Use the context already available, research only where it helps, and start with a small set I can review before anything is sent.

useCases.title: Send personalized client outreach
useCases.message: Help me reach out to these prospective or existing clients in our accepted voice. Use the context we already have, show me a useful first set, and get approval before sending.
